description: Call remote command to stop application and check that application stops while tail log

option.name: Service Address
option.help: URL or IP:PORT, several commas separated, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080,127.0.0.1:8090

option.name: Stop Successful Strings
option.help: If log encoding is not UTF-8, configure: {GBK} Start complete; leave as little as possible and replace it with a service address detection

option.name: Timeout (seconds)
option.help: Number of seconds to stop timeout, stop failure after timeout

option.name: Stop Backup Command
option.help: Apply stop, execute this command after detection has successfully stopped

option.name: Kill stopped the command.
option.help: For cases where Ctrl+C is required after certain stop commands have been successfully stopped

argument.name: Log Path
argument.help: Log path, which supports wildcards and inverts to display the startup log after the startup command
